summary.text: John Bucy is a Democratic state representative and small business owner from the Austin area who has represented Texas House District 136 since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: John Bucy III was born in Austin, Texas, and earned a B.A. in history from Austin College in 2006.
His career experience includes working as a small business owner.
Bucy defeated incumbent Tony Dale in the November 6, 2018 general election and assumed office on January 8, 2019.
In the 2023-2024 session he was vice chair of the Elections Committee and a member of the House Higher Education Committee.
He defeated Amin Salahuddin in the November 5, 2024 general election and advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary; Theodore Schramm is the Republican candidate in 2026.
